about: E11's CPU-twin hashes (build/m7/gpu, 2026-09-30; MSVC /fp:precise and clang-cl -ffp-contract=off agreed). Seed 20260930, 60 steps for the solves; 2^20 + 1024 rows (rows_quick: 65536 + 1024, lab.py run --quick). Every twin on every compiler and ISA must reproduce these; a GPU must match the twin of its own run. The positive controls (FMA contraction on the twin, fast math on the GPU) must not.

nan_variants.Fnocap: F without the speed cap: bodies blow up and NaNs appear, whose bits are each machine's own (x64 0xffc00000, ARM 0x7fc00000, NVIDIA GPUs 0x7fffffff), so its hashes hold on x64 only. Kept as the counter-example: a float core must never make a NaN.
